For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: March 22, 2018 - May 23, 2018, and May 6, 2019 - May 27, 2019
  • Number of Frames: 103,002 frames 
  • Resolution: 12 centimetre (RGBN)
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Four band (RGBN) 
  • Format: TIFF (ISAT model setup) 
  • Camera(s): Vexcel UltraCam X and Vexcel UltraCamEagle Frame based

 

For more information on the South Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (SCOOP) 2018 please see the main SCOOP 2018 GeoHub record. 

 
Available Products: 
Stereo Frames 
  • South Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (SCOOP) 2018 - Stereo Frames and associated AT Models 

Contact Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources - Geospatial Ontario, geospatial@ontario.ca
